published_prior_art.cite: TanChenDu2026NMTS: complete identification under context-independent inverse transport, but not a graph-budgeted fiber.
DuarteEtAl2024Autobounds: discrete polynomial-program sharp bounds, not a continuous shared-rank orientation polynomial.
TanChenDu2026NMTS: the zero-budget context-independent transport identification result.
LiuIhler2013MarginalMAP and DelPiaKhajavirad2024Hypergraph provide generic optimization machinery, not a continuous common-rank causal compiler.
Massart1990DKW and KaidoMolinariStoye2019Projection provide the band and projection primitives; the stated inclusion is their direct composition once the fiber is valid.

MastenPoirier2020Breakdown: decision breakdown frontiers; the integer graph-budget index is a downstream corollary of the proposed optimizer.

novelty_flags.label: Comparator promise table / DuarteEtAl2024Autobounds
novelty_flags.one_line: The table says Algorithm 1 gives sharp polynomial-program extrema, but the JASA paper assigns polynomialization to Algorithm 2 and ε-sharp optimization to Algorithm 3; Algorithm 1 is DAG canonicalization.

novelty_flags.label: bibliography and oeq:certified-shared-projection / TanBlanchetSyrgkanis2024NCPID
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited NeurIPS proceedings result is Theorem 4, not “Theorem 4.1,” and the cited “Proposition 4.2” is not a proceedings theorem locator; repair the anchors before relying on this comparison.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 (orientation-fiber)
soundness_flags.one_line: The converse is a direct restatement of def:graph-budget-scm-class, which already defines membership by existence of the same global field s and mechanisms Q_v∘ρ_{s_v}; state it as a definition/lemma or replace it with an independently characterized primitive class.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 4 (path-nesting-witness)
soundness_flags.one_line: W_4 specifies only a signed payoff table, not Q, E, a, h, and a legal triangular SCM instance, so its claimed L_K(Q),U_K(Q) values are not attached to the declared causal class.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 4 (path-nesting-witness)
soundness_flags.one_line: With the displayed W_4 payoff and s_1=+1, the TV≤1 fields give values −1/5, 1/10, −3/10, and 1/5, hence the K=1 hull is [−3/10,1/5], not [−1/5,2/5].

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6–7, Section 4 and Theorem 1; Appendix B.1, p. 23
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 makes the program produced by Algorithm 2 equivalent to the causal bounding problem; Algorithm 3 computes ε-sharp bounds, whereas Algorithm 1 canonicalizes hidden-variable DAGs.
The regularized neural partial-identification containment result is labeled Theorem 4 in the proceedings; Section 4.1 is an experiments subsection, not theorem numbering.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace W_4 by an explicit d-stage rational triangular SCM with declared Q_v, E, a, h, H, and an enumerated endpoint table; correct the K=1 values and use this legal instance as the compiler test.

Repair the DKW theorem by specifying a conditioning sigma-field that leaves each within-cell response sample i.i.d., or derive a sequential/martingale simultaneous band that remains valid under adaptive downstream cell membership.

Promote the substantive contribution by independently defining the admissible transport-failure class through primitive mechanism properties, then prove equivalence to the global orientation-field representation rather than defining the class through that representation.
Correct all theorem and algorithm anchors in the comparison table, especially Autobounds Algorithm 2/3 and the NeurIPS theorem numbering, then retain the narrower accurate comparisons.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle: repair the invalid W_4 witness and DKW conditioning argument, convert the definitional orientation-fiber result into a genuine characterization, and correct the two cited-result anchors before Stage 0.
